_doc: Reward penalty weights and curriculum thresholds for the R1 Level 0 trainer. Read by RobotControl/training/level0_env.py (Level0Config defaults) and mirrored by the Unreal DataAsset UR1RewardConfig (UnrealProject/Source/R1Twin/Public/R1RewardConfig.h); a pytest checks both. Weights are added to the per-step reward as weight * term (negative = penalty). torque_sq = sum(actuator force^2); joint_ang_vel_sq = sum(joint qvel^2); action_rate_sq = |a_t - a_{t-1}|^2; foot_slip = feet planar speed^2 while in contact. Level 0 hangs on a stand with no foot contact, so foot_slip is INACTIVE at Level 0 (kept for the levels that stand on the ground). The shipped r1_level0_upperbody policy was trained with these same weights before this file existed; it was not retrained.

curriculum.metric: fraction of the full command amplitude at iteration 0
mean tracking error (deg) below which the amplitude fraction grows by step per iteration
amplitude fraction at which the Level 0 curriculum is complete
